news_items.headline: Hesai Q1 2026 revenue up 29.6%, net income RMB18M
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 revenue RMB680.6M (+29.6% YoY); GAAP net income RMB18.3M, a turnaround from a RMB17.5M net loss in Q1 2025. 471,723 lidar units shipped (+140.9% YoY).

news_items.headline: Hesai Group (NASDAQ:HSAI) Q1 2026 Earnings Beat Profit Estimates on Robust Lidar Growth
news_items.summary: Q1 earnings beat profit estimates. ADAS lidar units +141.9% YoY to 353,441; robotics lidar +137.8% to 118,282. Q2 guidance RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY) above consensus.

news_items.headline: Hesai (HSAI) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news_items.summary: Management emphasized accelerating multi-lidar platform adoption and higher content per vehicle as L3 autonomy expands. Backlog exceeds 6 million units with significant new design wins in automotive and robotics.

news_items.headline: HESAI GROUP ($HSAI) Releases Q1 2026 Earnings
news_items.summary: Q1 release confirmed Mercedes-Benz strategic lidar partnership for L3 autonomy models. Pre-market shares rose ~9% on the beat plus above-consensus guidance.

news_items.headline: Why Hesai Group (HSAI) Is Up After Profit Rebound and Hong Kong Listing Plans
news_items.summary: Shares higher after profit rebound and disclosure of Hong Kong secondary listing plans. New ETX lidar reveal also cited as a catalyst.

news_items.headline: Hesai Group Is Up 13.1% After Profit Turnaround and New ETX Lidar Reveal
news_items.summary: Stock +13.1% on the session following profit turnaround and ETX lidar product reveal. Picasso 6D SPAD-SoC and Kosmo spatial intelligence device cited as moves into higher-margin software/data.
